name: mupibox-backend-api
author: Mupi Team

scripts.build: npm run check-types && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --target=node22 --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --metafile=backend-api.esbuild-meta.json --outfile=../deploy/server.js && npm run build:statics
scripts.build:statics: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for (const d of ['eltern-webapp','mupi-app']) fs.cpSync('src/'+d,'../deploy/'+d,{recursive:true,force:true,filter:(s)=>!/_parts|_source/.test(s)});fs.mkdirSync('../deploy/templates',{recursive:true});for (const f of ['mupiboxconfig.json','www.json']) fs.copyFileSync('../../config/templates/'+f,'../deploy/templates/'+f);fs.mkdirSync('../deploy/drivers',{recursive:true});for (const f of fs.readdirSync('../../scripts/online').filter((n)=>/^(install|remove)_rtl.*[.]sh$/.test(n))) fs.writeFileSync('../deploy/drivers/'+f,fs.readFileSync('../../scripts/online/'+f,'utf8').split(String.fromCharCode(13)).join(''))"

description: API backend server for the MupiBox.
